name: Platonic solids

sections.Properties:
Vertex transitive

sections.Derivatives:
Archimedian solids

trivia: 3 of the 5 platonic solids have been synthesized as [hydrocarbons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Platonic_hydrocarbon)
Many viruses have an icosahedral shell due to it being the simplest form that can be arranged from protein subunits
